description.zh:
数仓版集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~612241~~)接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~612241~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-all-data-source --db-cluster-id am-bp1pke2pcfavw0000 --schema-name adb_demo --table-name test --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb DescribeAllDataSource --region cn-hangzhou --TableName test --DBClusterId 'am-bp1pke2pcfavw0000' --SchemaName adb_demo
